inputRoute: Actual owned nested Wayland compositor, fixed keyboard-only nine transactions: Tab, Shift-F10, Tab, Tab, Shift-Tab, Escape, Shift-F10, Escape, Alt-F4. No pointer input. Original28+2/16-frame/phase and all source/ABI/process/input gates retained.
observedBehavior: The genuine taskbar menu follows Close/Refresh order, skips the disabled fact row, contains forward and reverse endpoint traversal, closes on Escape and returns focus to the exact eligible original observed group after a fresh read. Reopening and second dismissal restore the same group again. Normal unforced owned close and observer retirement complete. Independent Build review accepts only original ux-024.

steps.inputStep: Given a taskbar menu has focus, use Tab and Shift-Tab to traverse its documented eligible controls.
Continue traversal at both endpoints and remain within the current menu; disabled rows do not become actionable.
Press Escape to dismiss and restore the original eligible focus target.
